questions.s: DP2 Office Building and Rooftop Bar
questions.q: Which glass is best for the rooftop bar's dance floor?
questions.ref: General laminated and tempered glass practice for floors and walkable glazing
questions.n: Laminated glass has a plastic interlayer between glass sheets, so cracked pieces stay in place. Word root: laminate from Latin lamina, 'thin plate'. It acts like a sandwich: if one slice cracks, the filling holds it together.

questions.q: What is used to support and connect the ceiling boards to the structure?
o: Plywood strips glued to the roof
questions.ref: General coastal and tropical-house design practice; DENR coastal and foreshore regulations
questions.n: Furring forms a light frame for ceiling boards. Word root: furring from Old French fourrer, 'to line'. Metal avoids termites and sagging in humid sea air.

questions.q: What is a berm on a beach?
o: A natural raised sand ridge that acts as a barrier against waves and water
questions.ref: General coastal and tropical-house design practice; DENR coastal and foreshore regulations
questions.n: Mechanical beach raking flattens the berm and removes this natural water breaker. Word root: berm comes from French/Dutch berme, 'a narrow ledge'. Think of a sand speed bump against waves.

questions.q: Where should the water tank be placed on a sloping site?
o: In the center of the site only
At the lowest point of the site
At the highest point of the site
questions.ref: General socialized and economic housing practice (BP 220)
questions.n: Water flows downhill, so a high tank gives pressure without a pump. Think of a hilltop water tower.

questions.s: DP1 Beach House: Permits and Law
questions.q: Which clearance is commonly required first from the local community before a building permit?
questions.ref: DENR foreshore regulations; PD 1586 (Environmental Impact Statement System); local government building-permit requirements
questions.n: It is the first stamp in the permit chain. Think of it as asking the neighborhood for permission before applying to the city.

questions.q: Which fastener best resists corrosion near the sea?
questions.ref: General marine-environment materials and hardware practice (corrosion resistance)
questions.n: Electro-galvanized has a thin zinc coat that salt wears away fast. Hot-dip galvanized is better; stainless is best. The recall's stem was cut off, so this version asks the core point.

questions.q: Where should the septic tank be located on this beach site?
o: Below the garage next to the access road, far from the pool and the sea
questions.ref: General coastal and tropical-house design practice; DENR coastal and foreshore regulations
questions.n: Keep waste away from water, and keep it where the desludging truck can reach it. Word root: septic from Greek septikos, 'making rotten'. Think of the septic tank as the house's back-of-house, parked by the road.

questions.s: DP2 Office Building and Rooftop Bar
questions.q: Which ceiling system gives easy access to services with minimal damage during maintenance?
o: Acoustic tiles in a T-runner suspended grid
questions.ref: General office-planning, acoustics, and ceiling-system practice
questions.n: Lay-in tiles lift out and drop back, so no demolition. Gypsum is permanent, like a sealed lid. Word root: gypsum from Greek gypsos, 'chalk, plaster'.

questions.q: Which material is a good choice for the roof structure on this coastal site?
questions.ref: General marine-environment materials and hardware practice (corrosion resistance)
questions.n: It resists termites, rot, and salt when coated. The recall had no key; this is the most defensible answer for a coastal house.

questions.q: Which strategy best reduces low sunset glare while keeping the view?
o: Remove all shading and use clear glass
Long roof eaves combined with adjustable louvers or screens on the west side
questions.ref: General coastal and tropical-house design practice; DENR coastal and foreshore regulations
questions.n: The sun is low at sunset, so a flat overhang alone is not enough. Adjustable screens cut the glare, like the visor plus sunglasses. The recall's key was unclear, so know both ideas: eaves plus adjustable shading.

questions.q: Which cabinet type is cost-efficient and sturdy for the long term in a socialized condominium unit?
questions.ref: General socialized and economic housing practice (BP 220)
questions.n: Aluminum does not swell, warp, or feed termites in humid air, so it lasts. The recall had no key for this item; its starred choice was aluminum.

questions.s: DP1 Beach House: Permits and Law
questions.q: Which is a required clearance for building on the foreshore area?
o: Foreshore lease or permit from the DENR
questions.ref: DENR foreshore regulations; PD 1586 (Environmental Impact Statement System); local government building-permit requirements
questions.n: The foreshore is public land between high and low tide, so you need DENR permission to use it. Word root: foreshore = the shore in front of the land.

questions.q: Which door knob material is best near the sea?
questions.ref: General marine-environment materials and hardware practice (corrosion resistance)
questions.n: Bronze resists salt corrosion. Brass can lose its zinc in salt air (dezincification). The recall had a question mark here, so confirm with your reviewer. Word root: bronze from Italian bronzo.

questions.q: To give the owner privacy, how should the pods be placed on the sloping site?
o: Guest pods on top, master villa at the bottom
Master villa on top, guest pods lower toward the beach
All pods on one level in a row
Master villa beside the main gate
questions.ref: General coastal and tropical-house design practice; DENR coastal and foreshore regulations
questions.n: The master pod sits on the highest terrace, away from the beach crowd, with views over the guests' roofs. It is also nearest the arrival point, so a 68-year-old owner climbs less. Think of the master pod as the penthouse of the slope.

questions.s: DP1 Beach House: Permits and Law
questions.q: Under the Water Code, how wide is the easement along the seashore in urban areas?
questions.ref: PD 1067 (Water Code of the Philippines), Art. 51 (easements)
questions.n: Easements: 3 m urban, 20 m agricultural, 40 m forest. Memory trick: the more rural, the wider the strip.

questions.q: Which roof shape suits this windy, typhoon-prone coast?
o: Single-slope roof with large overhangs on all sides
Open gable roof with exposed ends
questions.ref: General coastal and tropical-house design practice; DENR coastal and foreshore regulations
questions.n: A hip roof slopes on all four sides, so wind slides over instead of lifting it. Vents let hot air escape. The recall options were incomplete, so this is the safest answer.

questions.q: What connects pods on a sloping site so an older owner and guests can move between them?
o: Ramps (general maximum 1:20 slope under the 2024 IRR)
questions.ref: 2024 Revised Implementing Rules and Regulations of BP 344, NCDA/DPWH
questions.n: Ramps keep the route accessible. The 2024 Revised IRR gives 1:20 as the general maximum, with 1:15 allowed in limited cases.

questions.s: DP2 Office Building and Rooftop Bar
questions.q: Which ceiling material suits an open office?
questions.ref: General office-planning, acoustics, and ceiling-system practice
questions.n: Acoustic tiles absorb echo, so an office stays quiet and comfortable. Word root: acoustic from Greek akouein, 'to hear'.

questions.q: What is commonly used to connect the roof structure to the concrete structure below?
questions.ref: General coastal and tropical-house design practice; DENR coastal and foreshore regulations
questions.n: Anchor bolts are cast into the concrete and hold the truss down in wind uplift, like tent stakes. The recall had no key.

questions.q: The housekeeper must clean several pods linked by ramps on a slope. Which storage plan is most efficient?
o: No storage; bring tools each day
One cleaning-storage cabinet in each pod
One centralized cleaning store for the whole site
questions.ref: General coastal and tropical-house design practice; DENR coastal and foreshore regulations
questions.n: Hauling mops up and down ramps wastes time, so each pod gets its own small store. The recall had no key for this one; the logic is to shorten travel.

questions.q: Which bedroom door fits an economic housing unit?
questions.ref: General socialized and economic housing practice (BP 220)
questions.n: Hollow-core doors are light and cheap and give basic privacy. The recall had no key; solid-core is for sound or security needs.

questions.s: DP1 Beach House: Permits and Law
questions.q: What does ECC stand for, and which agency issues it?
o: Electrical Code Compliance, issued by DPWH
Engineering Completion Certificate, issued by PRC
Environmental Clearance Contract, issued by the barangay
Environmental Compliance Certificate, issued by DENR-EMB
questions.ref: DENR foreshore regulations; PD 1586 (Environmental Impact Statement System); local government building-permit requirements
questions.n: The ECC shows the project passed environmental review. Coastal resorts are often required to get one.

questions.q: Which window handle material best resists stains and salt deposits?
questions.ref: General marine-environment materials and hardware practice (corrosion resistance)
questions.n: Plated coatings chip and then rust. Marine-grade stainless forms a self-healing skin, like a scab that regrows.

questions.q: The owner wants a balcony beside the master bedroom, and the site slopes toward the beach. Where should the master bedroom go without losing privacy?
questions.ref: General coastal and tropical-house design practice; DENR coastal and foreshore regulations
questions.n: People below cannot easily look up into a balcony, but a balcony can look down, so the owner is on top. Higher also means closer to the road for an older owner.

questions.s: DP2 Office Building and Rooftop Bar
questions.q: A 6-person meeting room is beside a 300-person function hall. What is the best way to reduce noise between them?
o: Place them back to back with no gap
Paint the wall a dark color
Put storage rooms or toilets between them as a buffer
questions.ref: General office-planning, acoustics, and ceiling-system practice
questions.n: Quiet and loud rooms need distance, so fill the gap with rooms that do not mind noise. Think of it as a hallway of storage rooms acting like a sound blanket. Porous materials soak up echo but do not block sound.

questions.q: Which roofing material is a good choice for this beach house?
o: Metal roofing with a marine-grade coating
questions.ref: General marine-environment materials and hardware practice (corrosion resistance)
questions.n: Pre-painted, coated metal sheds heavy rain and is light for typhoon uplift; pick a salt-resistant coating.

questions.q: Which set of challenges best describes the planning of this beach house?
o: Very quiet winds and no corrosion
Sloping site, salt-laden wind and typhoons, flooding or storm surge, and accessible movement between pods
A flat site and abundant parking
questions.ref: General coastal and tropical-house design practice; DENR coastal and foreshore regulations
questions.n: Each pod must deal with slope, salt, storms, and an older owner's mobility. Think of it as designing a house for a hill, a hurricane, and a long walk.
